correctness.rationale: Conjugacy/centralizer types follow from fixed-point-free action. The published Drinfeld-double sum is partitioned by u^k=1 and the exceptional u=1,h^{-1}; S_k(u) invertibility and character orthogonality yield four formulas. All A[k] nonzero points have free C_m orbits, ensuring integral output. Prime-to-m kernel order and t_(m l)=t_l recover elementary divisors. Independently checked the complement, nonzero kernel and inflated identity cases via direct S3 character sum, k=1..10; induced identity follows by orbit-character orthogonality. The two F7^2 actions are scalar versus nonscalar and hence distinct.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks are bounded; full quantifiers depend on inspected analytic or finite-exhaustive reduction arguments.
